title: VTA Notifications — Dismiss — payload
description: A client with standing in a trust context dismisses one notification its VTA holds there, so that it leaves the principal's default list. Dismissal is the principal's alone and changes nothing outside the VTA: the originator, any relayer and the thing's holder are told nothing, and the notification stays readable, and listable when asked for, until it lapses (VTI-NTF-052). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

changed.description: Whether this request dismissed it: false when it was already dismissed.
